channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: 'Hoarder' found with prohibited shotguns and cocaine in police search
item.description: A man stashed two shotguns, ammunition and cocaine in his home in FairOak.

item.title: Rare 50p coin sells for more than 225 times its face value in Southampton
item.description: A rare Royal Mint 50p coin has sold for more than £113 on eBay in Southampton, with there being a few coin designs worth a bit of money

item.title: Worker injured on Britannia sparks £9.7m legal battle with P&O Cruises
item.description: A popular Southampton cruise line is facing a multi-million-pound claim after workplace accident at sea.

item.title: Where in Southampton is King John's Palace and how did it get its name
item.description: Immediately, it's a name that evokes with it all the Plantagenet courtly drama and valour that we expect of a king who signed the Magna Carta.

item.title: Football club unveils plan to improve ground after player's death
item.description: A football club has unveiled plans to upgrade its ground after a 21-year-old player was killed in an accident at another stadium

item.title: Speeder clocked at 111mph on the M27
item.description: A motorist who hurtled along a Hampshire motorway at more than 110mph has appeared in court

item.title: Woman who ran into fire to save neighbours left with repair bill
item.description: A woman who tried to rescue her neighbours from a fire is now facing the cost of repairing her council-owned flat after it was left flooded by sprinklers.

item.title: Outrage as rubbish dumped beside graves in Southampton cemetery
item.description: Outrage has erupted after a pile of rubbish was dumped just metres from graves at a Southampton cemetery, leaving grieving families shocked and angry.

item.title: Curly Bites in Shirley launch public petition over canopy refusal by council
item.description: A small business in Shirley has launched a petition demanding clearer council rules on planning matters after an retrospective application for a canopy was refused.

item.title: Car wash worker on trial for causing colleague's death by reversing car onto him
item.description: A man is on trial for causing the death of his co-worker by hitting him with a customer's car at the car wash where they worked
